# US dollars moved between two US dollar accounts in the same transaction as a
# fee paid out of them, and in the same transaction as more dollars bought.
#
# A transfer draws down no cost basis and opens none: the book holds every
# dollar it held before. A fee spends dollars, and draws a cost basis down by
# what it spent; dollars bought open one for what arrived. Written in one
# transaction the two cannot be told apart — 4,010.00 USD leaving the bank and
# 4,000.00 arriving in savings says nothing about which 10.00 was the fee — and
# a cost basis is never guessed, so each is refused and written again as two
# transactions.
#
# What happens:
#
# - 2031-01-02  20,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2031-01-05  10,000.00 USD bought at 1.30 into the bank.
# - 2031-02-01  4,000.00 USD moved to savings with a 10.00 USD fee paid out of
#               the bank, in one transaction. Refused.
# - 2031-02-02  the same, as two transactions: the transfer, and the fee
#               drawing 10.00 on the cost basis. Imported.
# - 2031-03-01  3,000.00 USD moved to savings and 1,000.00 USD bought into
#               savings at 1.35, in one transaction. Refused.
# - 2031-03-02  the same, as two transactions: the transfer, and the purchase
#               opening a cost basis of 1,000.00. Imported.
#
# What is left: 2,990.00 USD in the bank and 8,000.00 in savings, and cost
# bases holding 9,990.00 at 1.30 and 1,000.00 at 1.35 — 10,990.00, what the
# accounts hold.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_transfer_shares_no_transaction_with_a_fee_or_new_money.py.
2031-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2031-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2031-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2031-01-01 open Assets:USD Savings
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2031-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2031-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 20000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -20000.00 CAD

2031-01-05 * "Buy 10,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 10000.00 USD
		guid: "e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e50001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "13000.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -13000.00 CAD

2031-02-01 * "Move 4,000.00 USD to savings and pay a 10.00 USD fee, in one"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -4010.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-5213.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e50001"
	Assets:USD Savings 4000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "5200.00"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 13.00 CAD

2031-02-02 * "Move 4,000.00 USD to savings"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Bank -4000.00 USD
	Assets:USD Savings 4000.00 USD

2031-02-02 * "Pay a 10.00 USD fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-13.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e50001"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 13.00 CAD

2031-03-01 * "Move 3,000.00 USD to savings and buy 1,000.00 more, in one"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Savings 4000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "21/16"
		value: "5250.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -3000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-3900.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1350.00 CAD

2031-03-02 * "Move 3,000.00 USD to savings"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Bank -3000.00 USD
	Assets:USD Savings 3000.00 USD

2031-03-02 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.35 into savings"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Savings 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "1350.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1350.00 CAD
